title: Smiling Well-Dressed Man on Rocks Outdoors, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a young man smartly dressed in 1940s attire, featuring wide-cut pleated trousers, a tailored suit jacket, a patterned necktie, and polished leather shoes. He stands with one hand tucked in his pocket atop a rocky formation, with bare trees and an open hillside extending behind him. The image is set within an Elko geometric decorative border, a distinctive staple of mid-century commercial photofinishing across the American Midwest.
